title: Integrate package manager adapter into AgentCore workflow
purpose: Wire the package adapter contract into AgentCore so package install workflows can run through generic PlanRun state without host mutation bypasses.
scope: Extend package install workflow to consume typed adapter reports.
Preserve isolated validation before host promotion.
Bind host promotion approval to package identity, source digest, and rollback id.
Project success, denial, and failure artifacts through runtime audit.
implementation_steps: Add or extend package workflow types in AgentCore using runtime_contracts types.
Add fixture-backed tests for metadata mismatch, isolated failure, denied host promotion, approved promotion, and rollback missing.
Ensure all host promotion paths require exact approval and SecurityExecution handoff.
Record evidence with test commands and audit projection examples.
acceptance_criteria: Package workflow cannot host-promote without isolated validation.
Approval mutation remains denied or paused.
Failed artifacts are redacted before projection.
failure_modes: Workflow executes host package manager directly.

blocked_until: Package workflow tests and evidence pass.
